description:
Transfer sBTC tokens to a recipient address.

sBTC uses 8 decimals (same as Bitcoin).
Example: To send 0.001 sBTC, use amount "100000" (satoshis).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount in satoshis (0.00000001 sBTC). Example: '100000' for 0.001 sBTC

fee.description: Optional fee: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' preset or micro-STX amount. If omitted, auto-estimated.

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: sbtc_transfer
